payload.title: Save, load, and classify with a versioned ClassifierBundle
payload.description:
## Purpose

Freeze each flywheel version as a versioned, verifiable `ClassifierBundle` that can be reloaded to classify new items.

## Scope (design §1.2)

- A directory with `bundle.json` (canonical text-free JSON, SHA-256 integrity hash, strict keys, in the `artifacts.py` style), `examples.jsonl` (private example texts, never committed, each row verified against manifest hashes on load), and `scorecard.yaml` (rubric and head in Jev-Flywheel `Score` format, hashed).
- `bundle.json` blocks: `task`, `engine` (adapter, configured and reported model, `model_identity`), `rubric`, `fewshot` (FixedExampleList + optimizer audit), `head`, `retrieval` (`null` by default), `lineage`.
- `load_bundle(dir)` verifies every hash and the task fingerprint, compares configured vs stored engine model, and warns if the reported model differs.
- `classify`: request 1 zero-shot (holistic question + every rubric element); request 2 few-shot with the fixed list; request 3 only when retrieval is enabled. Returns label, calibrated probability, top contributions.
- Core wraps the Jev-Flywheel YAML; it does not copy `Score`/`fit_head` (Q4 open). Keep the core interface provider-neutral.
- **Owner decision needed (Q2, request shape)** is tracked in the evaluations board; build the design's two-request shape unless the owner decides otherwise. Phase 2, design build step 9.

## Definition of done

Specs first: a reloaded bundle gives identical predictions to the in-memory one on a fake engine; a tampered file or mismatched example text is rejected; a reported-model mismatch produces an observable warning; no credentials or texts in `bundle.json`. `make test` green. Cost: $0.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Save, load, and classify with a versioned ClassifierBundle
  Scenario: A reloaded bundle predicts exactly like the original
    Given a classifier bundle built in memory with a fake engine
    When it is saved, reloaded, and asked to classify the same items
    Then the labels, probabilities, and contributions are identical
  Scenario: Tampering is detected
    Given a saved bundle whose examples file was edited
    When it is loaded
    Then loading fails with an integrity error before any model call
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.2, §1.3, §6 step 9, §7 Q2/Q4/Q6.
